description: Fixtures for the receiver-owned time observation origin contract (CHR-PROV-001..010).

cases.why: agent observation keyed by the propagated Praxis execution (ROS_EXECUTION_ID)
provenance record carried verbatim; originExecution is its contribution by the same actor
a system without a propagated Praxis execution keys its own run as EXE-<system>.<run>
unknown is recorded as unknown, never guessed
a human acting outside any run uses a CTB- key
a non-agent origin may omit the execution; absence stays absence
a newer minor of major 1 is accepted; fields it adds are preserved
a provenance record in an unsupported major is carried verbatim, not interpreted
a legacy bare {contributions} block is read as provenance v1
an agent origin must name the execution that produced it
an agent contribution is always keyed EXE-
an agent states provider, model, and runtime (unknown when unknown)
an origin without an actor is not an origin
unknown must be spelled unknown
kind outside the Praxis vocabulary
executions are EXE- or CTB- keys
identity never carries a credential
originExecution must be a contribution of the carried record
the carried record attributes the execution to a different actor (forged or confused origin)
malformed provenance (two creations) is reported, not dropped
an unsupported major of Chrona's own origin contract is an invalid payload
contract discriminator mismatch
